name: yaast
displayName: YAAST — Yet Another AI Summary Tool
description: Reads code so you don't have to. Inline AI-generated headers and file overviews above each symbol; hover for the full card.

untrustedWorkspaces.description: In restricted mode, summaries are disabled or limited to local-only providers.

commands.title: Semantic Fold Mode: Regenerate Summary at Cursor

semanticFoldMode.provider.description: Summary backend. 'cloud' uses the Anthropic API. 'static' produces deterministic non-AI headers.

semanticFoldMode.cloud.model.description: Anthropic model identifier when provider = 'cloud'. e.g. claude-haiku-4-5, claude-sonnet-4-6, claude-opus-4-7.

semanticFoldMode.debounceMs.description: Idle debounce before resummarizing dirty targets.

semanticFoldMode.cloud.batchSize.description: Max symbols per batched API call when generating summaries for a whole file.

semanticFoldMode.cloud.maxBatchInputChar.description: Approximate character budget per batch (≈ 4 chars per token). If a batch would exceed this, it splits into multiple calls.

semanticFoldMode.allowRemoteInTrustedOnl.description: Block cloud/remote summarization in untrusted workspaces.

semanticFoldMode.autoFoldOnOpen.description: Automatically fold all eligible symbol drawers when a file is opened.

semanticFoldMode.includeKinds.description: Symbol kinds eligible for drawer summaries.

scripts.pretest: npm run compile && npm run build
scripts.package: npm run build && vsce package --no-dependencies --skip-license -o yaast.vsix
